audit_scope: Public Corgi+ code, checkpoint, inference, training, input, reference, license, and nearest-comparator surface. No benchmark outcomes or sealed features were opened.

model_identity.scientific_identity: Corgi+ RNA-to-epigenomic imputation with DNA, global trans-regulator context, local stranded total-RNA coverage, a 22-track genomic-position mean baseline, and local RNA delta from that baseline.

article.method_surface: The final published Corgi+ auxiliary input is local total-RNA plus/minus, the 22 assay-specific training-context mean tracks, then local total-RNA plus/minus delta from the corresponding mean tracks.

inference.disposition: Architecture-level execution is not scientific task execution. Do not construct project predictions from synthetic or guessed auxiliary inputs.

training.reason_candidate_order_is_not_checkpoint: The 26-channel state shape and current trainer agree, but the checkpoint-producing source revision is unresolved and the paper reproduction gitlink is unavailable.
training.released_checkpoint_resume_completeness: UNVERIFIED; only the model-state tensor mapping was safely inventoried, and no optimizer/scheduler restore was attempted

source_data_zip_bounded_inventory.finding: The central directory contains figure source-table CSVs, including Figure 4 mean-baseline and Corgi+ result tables. It contains no tensor, checkpoint, reference-genome, preprocessing, mask, local-RNA, or portable inference-input member. Result-table contents were not opened.

current_login_environment.finding: The login environment is dependency-incomplete and is not a model execution environment. No dependency installation is authorized. The frozen isolated L40S compatibility runtime remains architecture evidence only.

blocking_gates.requirement: Recover or obtain upstream certification of the exact checkpoint-producing source revision and final mode.
Release or independently validate a safe strict loader that consumes every biological input with fixed order, transforms, crop, shift, reverse-complement, and output semantics.

Provide the native 22-track genomic-position mean-baseline tensor and transforms, or a prospectively authorized task-native construction with all 22 channels. Provide aligned stranded local total-RNA coverage; a gene-count matrix and zero-filled missing tracks are invalid substitutes.
Recover the modified hg38 FASTA and all coordinate/channel reference objects bound to the checkpoint.
Match an official fixed biological input/output fixture across full-window prediction and test-time augmentation. Synthetic shape and finite-value checks do not satisfy this gate.

After the biological-input and loader gates pass, safely inventory any optimizer and scheduler state, then prove deterministic local checkpoint save/resume and five-seed donor-by-genomic-fold adaptation without held-query ATAC. Only the model-state tensor mapping has been safely inventoried so far.
Resolve Apache-2.0 versus MIT code metadata and obtain an institutional or upstream determination for code adaptation and derivative-weight redistribution before open-champion use.

tournament_disposition.reevaluation_trigger: A new immutable upstream release or direct upstream clarification that closes the checkpoint-source, full-input, portable-loader, reference, and numeric-parity gates. License clearance is additionally required for an open champion or redistributed derivative.

nearest_legitimate_comparator.role: development-only native-family comparator using DNA plus the fold-fitted 2,891-gene global context and the regular 22-track output head
nearest_legitimate_comparator.why_nearest: It is the released base-family checkpoint and preserves the same long-range DNA, FiLM global-context, transformer, resolution, crop, and output-channel family while omitting Corgi+'s unavailable local-RNA, mean-baseline, and RNA-delta inputs.
nearest_legitimate_comparator.remaining_boundary: Regular Corgi is executable as a development comparator but remains ineligible for an open champion until its code terms, checkpoint-producing source, checkpoint-bound FASTA, and native numeric parity are resolved.
